choice_policy: Choose eligible library card by fixed commander-first candidate order Brainstorm, Ponder, Dark Ritual, Rite of Flame, Kessig Flamebreather, Sol Ring; restrict Mystical to spells of Oracle type instant/sorcery; if no priority match choose eligible card with highest mv then name as deterministic tie-break. This is one legal policy, not strategically optimal.
library_policy: Use actual frozen source card-model type tags (front card type), remove chosen library object, shuffle residual library, then put chosen target into hand or on library top; retain full 96-card source inventory, only moving zones. Never manufacture cards. Cycle 97 effect decline remains for unmodeled cards.
samples_policy: Same previous Cycle98 fixed scripted board, forced hand, injected mana, two removal profiles, 240 aligned baseline / variants, same seed; no card draws or tutor effects modeled beyond explicit named subset.
safeguards: Oracle verify card text, mana value and kind against pinned bulk
Test Mystical cannot choose creatures, lands or enchantments
Test tutors can change next cascade hit and hand access with two stacked cascades
Test life payment by Imperial/Vampiric is controller life only
Test library zone-card conservation and exact one searched card moved
Test no spontaneous cast, no fabricated legal targets, no false performance ranking
Reproduce fixed-seed pair results and preserve baseline hash across both swaps
Cycle98 original script/results and canonical decklist/approvals immutable
limits: No realistic hand draws, mana engine use, tutoring optimization, opponent stack responses, combat, target-quality or win-rate simulation
Simulated tutors choose from script-defined deterministic targets without modeling player judgment, responses or opponent library.
Specific supported tutor resolution increases coverage but does not establish deck power, Phase B, independent Pass C or M6 approval.
